description.name: Entry
description.text: Activates Holy Chain (max 150, field +50%), grants [Buff Holy 10% (5s)]/[Buff Holy 20% (5s)]/[Buff Holy 30% (5s)] if 0-1/2-3/4+ allies have any [Attach Holy], grants [ATK +50% (25s)], grants [Instant Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Buff Holy 10% (5s)
description.text: Increases Holy damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Holy 20% (5s)
description.text: Increases Holy damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Holy 30% (5s)
description.text: Increases Holy damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%
